title: Vendor sync-roadmap Claude command
description: Add the live ~/.claude/commands/sync-roadmap.md command to dot_claude so it replicates through chezmoi.

title: Add npm global bin to shell PATH
description: Expose npm global binaries installed under ~/.npm-global/bin across managed shells and persist npm prefix.
close_reason: Added ~/.npm-global/bin to zsh, bash, and fish PATH plus tracked npm prefix config.

title: Persist check-test-exists monorepo hook patch
description: Preserve the local monorepo-aware check-test-exists hook logic in dot_claude so chezmoi apply no longer prompts to overwrite it.
close_reason: Persisted monorepo-aware check-test-exists hook logic in dot_claude.

title: Apply Claude upstream update and zjstatus bump
description: Apply the validated Claude upstream update, improve patch reporting for chezmoi file naming, verify CI, and bump zjstatus.
close_reason: Applied Claude upstream update to 59f35666, normalized patch reporting, fixed validation script issues, and bumped zjstatus to v0.23.0.

title: Industrialize Claude upstream workflow
description: Add reproducible tooling and docs for updating vendored dot_claude from upstream while preserving local patches in chezmoi.
acceptance_criteria: Upstream metadata, update script, local patch docs, CI validation, and tracked-state checks exist; dot_claude remains tracked and replicable via chezmoi.
close_reason: Added Claude upstream metadata, vendor verification, 3-way update tooling, patch reporting, docs, and CI validation.

title: Proactively detect SSH apply conflicts
description: Improve chezmoi-autoupdate so known sensitive target conflicts such as ~/.ssh are detected before apply and logged clearly without blocking.
acceptance_criteria: autoupdate performs a non-interactive sensitive target preflight before apply and skips apply with a clear resolution hint when conflicts are detected.
close_reason: chezmoi-autoupdate now runs a sensitive target preflight for ~/.ssh with chezmoi verify before apply, skips apply on drift, and logs a manual resolution hint.

title: Improve autoupdate conflict reporting
description: When chezmoi-autoupdate fails on local target conflicts, log the affected targets and a manual resolution hint.
acceptance_criteria: Autoupdate logs conflict target names and suggested manual command when chezmoi reports local target changes.
close_reason: chezmoi-autoupdate now parses local target conflict prompts from its log, records affected targets, and logs a manual resolution hint.

title: Prevent autoupdate prompt hangs
description: chezmoi-autoupdate can block on target-file prompts such as changed ~/.ssh. Make unattended update non-interactive with closed stdin and timeout.
acceptance_criteria: autoupdate never blocks on chezmoi prompts; source update and apply are logged separately; prompt conflicts fail safely without overwrite.
close_reason: Split update/apply phases, closed stdin for both, and added CHEZMOI_AUTOUPDATE_TIMEOUT so target prompts fail safely instead of hanging.

title: Align aictx docs CLI and config behavior
description: Resolve drift between documented aictx commands/config and actual Rust CLI behavior. Audit found documented enable/disable commands missing, --auto parsed but ignored, MCP defaults not written, and generated shell hooks diverging from hand-written hooks.
acceptance_criteria: README, CLAUDE guidance, completions, defaults.yaml, and Rust CLI agree; unsupported commands are removed or implemented; --auto behavior is defined; MCP support is either implemented or removed from defaults.
close_reason: Aligned docs-facing behavior and config: removed stale enable/disable completions/messages, made MCP selections opt-in in defaults, added missing hooks/gemini/copilot defaults, and verified aictx tests pass.

title: Split package upgrades from unattended dotfile sync
description: The hourly autoupdate path can trigger package manager upgrades when update scripts change. Split lightweight dotfile sync from system/package upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Unattended timer does not run apt/dnf/pacman/rpm-ostree/brew upgrades by default; upgrades require manual command or explicit config flag; docs explain the split.
close_reason: Update scripts now skip package upgrades during unattended autoupdate unless CHEZMOI_AUTOUPDATE_UPGRADES=1 is explicitly set; maintenance docs and autoupdate env docs explain the split.

title: Make aictx symlink cleanup ownership-aware
description: Current aictx symlink application removes all symlinks in target resource directories, which can delete user-managed links. Introduce an ownership manifest or equivalent guard.
acceptance_criteria: aictx removes only symlinks it previously created; user-managed symlinks survive apply/reset; regression tests cover mixed owned and unowned symlinks.
close_reason: Symlink cleanup now removes only links pointing under the relevant aictx source root and preserves user-managed links/files; added ownership tests and verified cargo test passes.

title: Make chezmoi autoupdate safe by default
description: Harden unattended chezmoi autoupdate so it never loses local work or mutates Git remotes unexpectedly. Follow-up from repo maintenance audit.
acceptance_criteria: Autoupdate exits safely on conflicts or dirty source state; destructive recovery requires explicit opt-in; remote URL is never rewritten automatically; unattended updates do not run forced applies.
close_reason: Implemented safe default behavior: autoupdate now skips dirty/conflicted source state, destructive recovery requires CHEZMOI_AUTOUPDATE_DESTRUCTIVE=1, remotes are not rewritten, and unattended update no longer uses --force.

title: Audit chezmoi auto commit defaults
description: Review and adjust .chezmoi.toml.tmpl autoAdd/autoCommit/autoPush defaults according to the documented plan.
acceptance_criteria: Defaults are safer by profile; template renders; docs are updated with final behavior.
close_reason: Changed broad chezmoi autoAdd/autoCommit/autoPush to opt-in via CHEZMOI_AUTO_GIT=1, updated wrapper-owned manifest sync for pacman/yay/rpm-ostree, refreshed docs, and verified template renders false by default / true with opt-in.

title: Add minimal dotfiles CI
description: Add GitHub Actions workflow for template/script checks, Zellij updater validation, aictx tests, and whitespace checks.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs on push/PR and covers chezmoi-test-scripts, update-zellij-plugins syntax/lock validation, aictx cargo tests, and git diff --check.
close_reason: Extended validate.yml with whitespace checks, chezmoi-test-scripts, Zellij updater validation, and aictx fmt/check/test; local CI-equivalent checks pass.

title: Add global chezmoi diff verification
description: Extend chezmoi-test-scripts with a non-interactive chezmoi diff/render gate to catch global template errors earlier.
acceptance_criteria: chezmoi-test-scripts runs a non-interactive chezmoi diff check and documents the behavior.
close_reason: chezmoi-test-scripts now runs a non-interactive chezmoi diff against CHEZMOI_DESTINATION_PATH or HOME; verified render/diff check passes with a temp destination.

title: Add AI resource dedup inventory command
description: Add a safe report command to inventory duplicate resources between dot_claude and dot_aictx before cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Command reports identical, different, Claude-only, and aictx-only resources by category without modifying files.
close_reason: Added ai-resource-dedup-report and documented it; verified it reports per-category duplicate counts without modifying files.

title: Add reproducible Zellij plugin updater
description: Replace manual WASM upgrade flow with a pinned manifest and updater for tracked Zellij plugins.
acceptance_criteria: A plugin lock/manifest pins source repo, release/version, asset URL, and sha256; an update-zellij-plugins command downloads to a temp file, verifies checksum before replacement, and updates docs; empty local placeholder remains documented.
close_reason: Added plugins.lock.json and update-zellij-plugins with pinned verify/reinstall, --check latest release reporting, --bump opt-in upgrades, temp downloads, and SHA-256 verification before replacement.

title: Audit large tracked files
description: Identify large tracked files and document remaining intentional binaries or cleanup candidates.
acceptance_criteria: Large tracked files are audited; intentional binaries are documented; cleanup candidates are captured.
close_reason: Added docs/LARGE_FILES.md with top tracked files, decisions, and cleanup candidates; confirmed Rust target artifacts remain untracked.

title: Add manual package upgrade command
description: Create a clear manual command for package/system upgrades so unattended dotfile sync stays lightweight.
acceptance_criteria: Manual upgrade command exists; docs explain it; autoupdate remains opt-in for upgrades.
close_reason: Added cmupgrade manual upgrade command and documented usage in dot_local/bin/README.md; unattended autoupdate remains lightweight.

title: Add chezmoi script render tests
description: Add a local verification command that renders chezmoi script templates and runs syntax checks where possible.
acceptance_criteria: A script or command verifies chezmoi templates render and shell scripts pass syntax checks; command is documented.
close_reason: Added chezmoi-test-scripts command; verified 36 templates render and 29 non-empty scripts syntax-check with zero failures.

title: Add provenance for vendored AI resources and binary plugins
description: dot_aictx, dot_claude, and zellij wasm plugins are tracked content with external provenance. Add machine-readable or documented source/version/checksum metadata.
acceptance_criteria: dot_aictx and dot_claude document upstream source, commit/version, update command, and local patches; tracked zellij wasm plugins document source URL and checksum or are replaced by reproducible install scripts.
close_reason: Added docs/PROVENANCE.md with dot_claude upstream pin, dot_aictx lockfile provenance, zellij WASM source URLs/update commands/checksums, and updated maintenance guidance.

title: Convert evolving package installers to run_onchange manifests
description: Several package installers are run_once despite containing evolving package lists, and Windows docs mention Scoopfile.json while installer hardcodes packages.
acceptance_criteria: Flatpak, Windows, and toolbox package flows rerun when their manifests/lists change; Windows installer consumes Scoopfile.json; docs match actual package sources.
close_reason: Converted Flatpak, Windows Scoop, and toolbox installers to run_onchange; Windows installer now embeds and consumes dot_private/Scoopfile.json; templates render successfully.

title: Plan chezmoi auto-commit defaults audit
description: Document a plan for reviewing .chezmoi.toml.tmpl autoAdd/autoCommit/autoPush defaults by machine profile.
acceptance_criteria: Plan explains current risks, recommended defaults, migration steps, and rollback without changing behavior yet.
close_reason: Added docs/CHEZMOI_AUTOCOMMIT_PLAN.md documenting risks, recommended defaults, audit steps, and rollback for autoAdd/autoCommit/autoPush.

title: Trust audited RTK project filters
description: Audit project-local RTK filters and trust them if no active risky filter exists.
acceptance_criteria: RTK no longer warns about untrusted project filters after audit.
close_reason: Audited .rtk/filters.toml; it only contains inactive template comments, then ran rtk trust successfully.

title: Plan dot_claude dot_aictx deduplication
description: Produce a plan for reducing duplication between dot_claude and dot_aictx without breaking deployed CLI resources.
acceptance_criteria: Plan identifies duplicate categories, source of truth, migration steps, risks, and rollback.
close_reason: Added docs/AI_RESOURCE_DEDUP_PLAN.md with source-of-truth model, migration steps, risks, and rollback plan.
